edit: same in a fresh venv with just "pip install pytest==7.4.4"
`configfile: setup.cfg` - have you also tried in a clean directory outside of your project dir so that no config is picked up?

yes, I did, to remove any doubts:

```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir pytest==7.4.4

RUN echo 'from unittest import TestCase, skipIf\n\
import pytest\n\
@skipIf(True, "reason")\n\
class Foo(TestCase):\n\
    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\n\
    def something(self):\n\
        assert 0\n\
    def test_bar(self):\n\
        pass\n' > /test_file.py

RUN pytest /test_file.py
```

This also reveals that it actually changed between 8.0.2 and 8.1.0.

Oh, it looks like you edited your example (to move the fixture inside of the class) while I was looking at the issue and already had the code saved... With the same code I indeed get the same behavior you describe, that makes more sense now.
